content.text: While it runs, I'll document the difficulty tags in the README and the Agent Note.

input.command:
cd /c/Users/shrey/Desktop/Elemental_harness && python - <<'EOF'
p='scripts/eval/README.md'
s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
a="## Metrics\n"
add='''## Difficulty

Each task is tagged by what makes its file hard to find from the failing test:

| Tag | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `cross-package` | A fix file lives in a different package or app than every failing test |
| `indirect` | No failing test imports a fix file, so the agent must trace the call path |
| `multi-file` | The fix spans more than one source file, and all must be found |
| `direct` | None of the above: the test imports the fix file in its own package (the control case) |

`--hard` runs only tagged tasks, taking `cross-package`, `indirect`, and `multi-file` in turn so each kind is represented. Tags appear in the log, each `<task>.json`, and `summary.md`.

'''
assert a in s
s=s.replace(a,add+a,1)
s=s.replace("pnpm run eval:file-finding -- --repo <path-to-repo> --limit 20 --out eval-results\n```",
"pnpm run eval:file-finding -- --repo <path-to-repo> --limit 20 --out eval-results\n\n# Edge cases only: tasks where the failing test does not lead straight to the fix.\npnpm run eval:file-finding -- --repo <path-to-repo> --hard --limit 6\n\n# A model from an existing DSH home (e.g. a custom provider), and specific tasks.\nDSH_EVAL_PROVIDER=<provider id> DSH_EVAL_MODEL=<model id> pnpm run eval:file-finding -- --repo <path-to-repo> --home-from ~/.dsh --only <hash>,<hash>\n```",1)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf8',newline='\n').write(s)
p='.agents/notes/implemented/testing/2026-09-29-file-finding-evaluation.md'
s=open(p,encoding='utf8').read()
a="- **Metrics.**"
add="- **Difficulty.** Each task is tagged `cross-package` (a fix file is outside every failing test's package), `indirect` (no failing test imports a fix file), `multi-file`, or `direct`. `--hard` runs the tagged kinds round-robin, because a first live run showed a `direct`-style task tells little: the agent read the right file at step 1. Of the 111 newest candidates, 43 are direct, 25 indirect, 12 cross-package, and 50 multi-file.\n"
assert a in s
s=s.replace(a,add+a,1)
open(p,'w',encoding='utf8',newline='\n').write(s)
EOF
git status --short
input.description: Document difficulty tags in README and the Agent Note
